default_instruction: Treat this as project context. Discover and operate on it only through python tools/f1c_mod.py; do not invent a direct helper invocation.

routing_rules.instruction: Read-only Windows MCP backend; only use python tools/f1c_mod.py memory-mcp. Fixed positions operation includes excluded terminal slots, not external collider enumeration. See tools/sdk/F1C_MEMORY_MCP.md.
This is the only supported user/LLM executable interface. Use its subcommands and help output.
Public headers, broker ABI, contracts, templates, and tests. Consume through tools/f1c_mod.py; edit reviewed public surfaces only with evidence and tests.
Preserved implementation module. Never invoke directly in a modding workflow; use the matching tools/f1c_mod.py command.
Supported isolated mod workspace. Create, validate, build, test, trace, and stage it through tools/f1c_mod.py.
Preserved legacy SDK export for old builds only. Do not use for new work; query and generate from the canonical SDK through tools/f1c_mod.py.
Preserved prototypes, production mods, and historical experiments. Read-only evidence unless explicitly promoted into an SDK sandbox through tools/f1c_mod.py.
Preserved, paused replacement-engine experiment. It is outside the current mod-SDK goal; do not build or extend it from an SDK task.
Preserved reconstruction evidence and historical worker output. Search or inspect it through tools/f1c_mod.py; do not resume engine reconstruction.
Raw decompiler evidence. Never rewrite it; use tools/f1c_mod.py search or inspect.
Typed Hex-Rays export of the reviewed lab IDB (see MANIFEST.json). Never rewrite it; regenerate into a new directory with tools/f1c_mod.py ida-export and read it with search or inspect.

Static analysis evidence. Never rewrite it; use tools/f1c_mod.py search or inspect.

Machine evidence and indexes. Consume through tools/f1c_mod.py and preserve provenance.
Observed runtime evidence. Consume through tools/f1c_mod.py memory and runtime commands; never treat observation alone as a safe write contract.
Preserved experiment records. Use as leads via tools/f1c_mod.py, not as current execution instructions.
Evidence-linked research reference. Query through tools/f1c_mod.py and obey each claim's trust tier.
Distribution UI, not an SDK or reverse-engineering entry point. It may consume only artifacts validated and staged through tools/f1c_mod.py.

prohibitions: Do not delete, move, or rewrite evidence merely to modernize its wording.
Do not invoke internal tools/*.py files directly from active instructions.
Do not hard-code a raw address or duplicate a hook already owned by the broker.
Do not use QuickRace; live validation uses the f1cm_guard.asi full-weekend launch path.
Do not modify the original executable or production mod tree.
